title: design-step-gains-gated-exits
what: The design step in a ticket's workflow becomes a node with gated exits (intentions cleared, tickets reviewed) where back-to-design routes, making non-linearity structural rather than ad hoc.
how: Charter update (skills/design/intention+why.json — add exit gate fields) + door.py update (skills/design/door.py — enforce the new fields on exit) + probe (skills/design/probes/design_exit_gates_fire.py).
traces_to: Law 1 (the resolver spent on the novel — re-deriving design is the defect), Law 3 (nothing is known until measured — each design crossing is measured with gate evidence)
state: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> WATCHME(design-exit-gates-fire) -> [PROVED]
falsifier: A ticket routed back from /sorted goes through /design, both exit gates check (intentions cleared, tickets reviewed), re-enters BUILDME, and the two design-node crossings are visible in the ticket's history with distinct gate evidence. If the gates cannot be checked or the loop-back produces no evidence distinguishable from a first pass, the intent was wrong.

watchme.trigger: every /design door firing — the probe reads the berth the door writes
watchme.enough: one ticket that entered from sorted (a return trip) and exited with both gate fields (intentions_cleared, tickets_reviewed) populated and checked
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier
watchme.consumer: /design's own charter and the state-machine-physics ticket

gates_bound.build: the build gate inspects the charter update and door.py changes
gates_bound.proof: the door refuses a packet missing the new exit-gate fields; a conforming packet with gate evidence berths
